description: r0b0tlab's native-SM121 vLLM 0.25.0 profile for NVIDIA's Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-NVFP4 (ModelOpt; Apache-2.0) with MTP K=2 on one Spark, from r0b0tlab/qwen36-35b-a3b-nvfp4-sm121-vllm at 106fb533 (MIT), bound to checkpoint revision 491c2f1e as upstream recorded. Builds on r0b0tlab's digest-pinned vllm-v0250-cu130-sm121 image (vLLM release commit 702f4814) and applies upstream's Dockerfile.v025 patch that routes W4A16 ModelOpt checkpoints onto the native W4A4 path. Profile: FlashInfer attention, FlashInfer B12X MoE, FlashInfer CUTLASS linear, modelopt_mixed quantization, FP8 KV, memory utilisation 0.88, 65,536-token context (upstream validated the full 262,144 tokens at c1 with a separate explicit-KV launch), 32 sequences, 32,768 batched tokens, text-only (language-model-only), qwen3_xml tool parser and MTP with a Triton drafter MoE. Options expose upstream's env switches for MTP and language-model-only. Upstream claims (not measured here): GSM8K 86.50%, MTP acceptance 78.56%, 93.05 tok/s at c1, 287.18 at c8 and 397.98 at c32 (2,048-token inputs). Physical Spark acceptance is pending. Memory follows the creator's settings: gpu-memory-utilization 0.88 with no explicit KV pool, as in r0b0tlab's Dockerfile.v025 at 106fb533 (line 23). The steady peak is 0.88 x 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus 8 GB for CUDA context, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers (a speculative draft is profiled inside the utilization budget); the reserve is 8 GB, and admission keeps the platform memory floor free beside the peak.
title: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B NVFP4 MTP vLLM single Spark (r0b0tlab)
